Document No.: OCR-086-r0a | Equipment:
 Overcurrent and Earth Leakage Protection
 R3AS7ek

 Single-phase secondary current injection device

Introduction
This document sets out the steps to be followed when testing the overcurrent and earth leakage protection device, model R3AS7ek.
This document was prepared by Alexandria Electricity Distribution Company and was reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators.
Safety Precautions
Notify the competent control/operation of the cells on which the protection is to be tested. | 
Issue an approved work order specifying the work location and the work team, observing occupational safety and health rules. | 
The work team must carry the occupational safety and health category card. | 
Ensure the cell circuit breaker is switched off by the competent operation technician and the circuit breaker placed in the test position. | 
Ensure warning signs are posted on the cells to be worked on. | 
Ensure the protection device is earthed. | 
Observe polarity when dealing with DC voltage.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Secondary current injection device. | 
Blower device for removing dust. | 
Cleaner (spray). | 
Variable current source for supplying the test device with the appropriate voltage. | 
(Pliers + screwdrivers) for dealing with the device terminals. | 
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: Testing the Overcurrent Characteristic
Use the blower device to remove dust from the protection device | 1.
Supply the test device from the variable current source 220 VAC | 2.
Place the test device leads on the protection device | 3.
Ensure the DC auxiliary voltage is present on the protection device | 4.
Prepare the injection device and supply it with the appropriate AC auxiliary voltage for operation | 5.
Connect the current leads to the protection device at points (1,6) as in the figure | 6.
Raise the current gradually until reaching the pickup current I pick up of the protection device and record this value | 7.
Lower the current gradually until reaching the I Reset current of the protection device and record this value | 8.
Calculate the reset factor K reset factor = I reset / Ipick up > 85%, for electromechanical devices | 9.
Repeat these steps for the second and third phases | 10.
Connect the Trip leads of the device to the Stop timer terminals of the secondary injection device to calculate the tripping time, on terminals (14,15) | 11.
Second: Testing the Instantaneous Short-Circuit Current Element
Connect the current leads to the protection device at points (1,6) | 1.
Raise the current gradually until reaching the pickup current I pick up of the protection device and record this value | 2.
Lower the current gradually until reaching the I Reset current of the protection device and record this value | 3.
Repeat these steps for the second and third phases | 4.
Connect the Trip leads of the device to the Stop timer terminals of the secondary injection device to calculate the tripping time on terminals (14,15) | 5.
Third: Testing the Earth Leakage Characteristic
Connect the current leads to the protection device at points (3,6) as in the figure | 1.
Raise the current gradually until reaching the pickup current I pick up of the protection device and record this value | 2.
Lower the current gradually until reaching the I reset current of the protection device and record this value | 3.
Calculate the reset factor K reset factor = Ireset / Ipick up | 4.
Connect the Trip leads of the device to the Stop timer terminals of the secondary injection device to calculate the tripping time on terminals (12,13) | 5.
